value.body: Master's programmes in public policy (MPP, MA Public Policy and similar) teach how government decisions are designed, analysed and evaluated. Courses usually combine economics, political science, law, statistics and programme evaluation, often with a field project or internship. They are offered by public and private universities and a few national law schools in India.

items.label: Degree names
items.value: MPP, MA Public Policy, MA Public Policy & Governance

items.label: Fees
items.note: Public universities charge far less than private ones; check each official fee notice

items.label: Students in programmes recorded as 'Master of Public Policy (MPP)'
items.note: Many policy master's are recorded under M.A. and are not counted here, so the real number of policy students is higher
items.source: AISHE 2023-24, Ministry of Education (Table 11, all modes)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's degree in any discipline. Some universities admit through CUET-PG; others use their own written test, statement of purpose and interview. Some programmes prefer or require work experience.

value.title: At a glance
items: Outcomes depend heavily on internships and networks; there is no single entry exam for policy jobs.
Common destinations: think tanks, NGOs and development agencies, CSR teams, government fellowship programmes and consulting.
Many people work for a few years first, since experience helps both admission and placement.
